### Distorted Vision
Author: T. Suzanne Eller
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-aug-13-2009-11607287.html
Passage: 1 Timothy 6:6
Points:
- Longing for unattainable things blinds us to the blessings we already possess.
- Fixating on what we lack warps our perspective and fosters chronic discontent.
- Contentment begins by choosing to notice and appreciate God's everyday provisions.
- Redirecting our thoughts toward meeting the needs of others frees us from self-absorption.
- Godly contentment is an inner work of divine grace that produces true spiritual wealth.

### The Great Gain of Godly Contentment
Author: Emily Rose Massey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-great-gain-of-godly-contentment-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: 1 Timothy 6:6-8
Points:
- Comparing our lives to curated social media posts fuels envy and feelings of inadequacy.
- Discontentment reflects a lack of faith in God's loving and sovereign care.
- Basic necessities like food and clothing provide sufficient reason for believers to be satisfied.
- Extra material possessions should be received with thanksgiving rather than entitlement.
- Resting in Christ and His Word restores eternal perspective and brings lasting peace.
